production.scenario: events suite (r1-ws, r1-lp, r2-ws, r2-lp; web SDK, WebSocket and long polling, 2 rounds; 8 cases, 32 steps per profile): key_window (orderByKey limitToFirst(2) and limitToLast(2) while keys are added inside, before and after and the first removed), priority_window (orderByPriority limitToFirst(2) with setPriority, setWithPriority and a remove across the edge), value_range (orderByValue startAt(4)/endAt(8) with values moving in and out), equal_events (orderByChild('t') equalTo(2) with a field moving in and out and a write that changes nothing), cursor_pair (orderByChild('s') startAt(1,'b')/endAt(1,'c') on tied values: get, listener, a write inside), fanout (value and child listeners at a parent and two children, a multi-path update at the root, then a set of the parent), transactions (absent node, abort by returning undefined, object) with listeners on the three paths and the transaction writer's own events and resolution, get_exists (get of a limitToFirst(2) window and of a missing path); the ordered child_added/changed/moved/removed callbacks with prevName and the value callbacks of each step. Admin suite (r1-admin, r2-admin; firebase-admin 14.3.0 over WebSocket, 2 rounds; 10 cases, 16 steps per profile) under Rules that deny every client: set, get, multi-key update, push (the key's shape only), transactions on an absent node, an object and an abort, remove, a value and child_added listener on an orderByChild('s') limitToFirst(2) window with a write in between, and a get of a path under explicit deny Rules (the Admin SDK bypass).
production.credential: the gcloud user OAuth access token of the operator, passed to firebase-admin 14.3.0 as a custom credential; not a service account
production.closeRow: sandbox-ledger lines 1252 (booking) and 1253 (close); approval and V lines owner-decisions.md 2227 and 2228; cleanup of prefix and Rules verified

judging: tools/sdk-smoke-database/rtdb-sdk-events-judge.mjs (admin step tables in rtdb-sdk-admin-judge.mjs): per profile, case and step the recorded facts are compared exactly, member order included: the ordered observer callbacks (listener label, event, key, prevName, exported value), the writer's ordered callbacks and transaction resolution, the acknowledgement, the get and transaction results. No timings are compared and no masks are applied (the admin push records only the key's shape). A step whose quiescence or readiness bound was hit, a missing, extra, failed or out-of-place case, a journal fault, an incomplete run and an Admin SDK credential outcome fail closed.
scope: The 160 recorded steps only (52 observations: 8 events cases x 4 profiles, 10 admin cases x 2 profiles). The Admin SDK authenticated with the operator's gcloud user OAuth access token passed as a custom credential: a service-account Admin SDK credential is not claimed. Not claimed: other windows, cursors and query combinations, applyLocally false, a write covering several per-path listens of one connection (that onDisconnect shape stays /knownDifferences/rootWriteListenOrder; the recorded fanout case is a multi-path update with listeners at a parent and its children), raw wire frames, timings and latency (/outOfScope of RTDB.json).
